name: Kassety
source:
Andrei Krestovozdvizhenskiy has a demanding, albeit sedentary job - he digitises videos from old tapes. In general, nothing interesting - B movies, recordings of old shows or amateur erotica.
But sometimes the tapes contain something that cannot be explained or at least comprehended.

[Translated from [url=https://yokarnii-babai.itch.io/kasseti]Itch[/url]]
translation:
安德烈·克雷斯托沃兹德维真斯基 (Andrei Krestovozdvizhenskiy) 的工作要求较高，但需要久坐，他将旧磁带中的视频数字化。一般来说，没有什么有趣的——B级电影、老节目的录音或业余情色片。
但有时录音带中包含一些无法解释或至少无法理解的内容。

[译自[url=https://yokarnii-babai.itch.io/kasseti]Itch[/url]]
